sub_parameters.name: host
sub_parameters.description: The IP address of the node.

sub_parameters.name: port
sub_parameters.description: The access port number of the node.

sub_parameters.name: zoneId
sub_parameters.description: The zone ID of the instance node. For example, the zone ID for China (Shanghai) Zone C is cn-shanghai-c.

parameters.name: clientToken
parameters.description: A unique token used to ensure the idempotence of the request. This parameter value is generated by the client and must be unique among different requests. The value cannot exceed 64 ASCII characters in length.

parameters.name: nodeType
parameters.description:
The node type. Valid values:

- WORKER: hot node
- WORKER_WARM: warm node
